from openpyxl import load_workbook
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/41-12/1_41-12_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/41-12_0_50426e9c/1_41-12_output.xlsx"

# Preserve rich text where supported, so bold information in rich-text runs is not lost.
try:
    wb = load_workbook(input_path, rich_text=True)
except TypeError:
    wb = load_workbook(input_path)

ws = wb.active

def cell_has_bold_format(cell):
    """Return True if the cell's displayed/stored text is bold by whole-cell font
    or by rich-text runs (when openpyxl exposes them)."""
    if bool(getattr(cell.font, "bold", False)):
        return True

    value = cell.value
    # openpyxl rich text values may be CellRichText (iterable of strings/TextBlock objects).
    if value is not None and not isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            runs = list(value)
        except TypeError:
            runs = []
        for run in runs:
            # TextBlock has .font; font may be InlineFont with .b/.bold.
            font = getattr(run, "font", None)
            if font is not None and (bool(getattr(font, "bold", False)) or bool(getattr(font, "b", False))):
                return True
    return False

bold_name_count = 0
for row in range(7, 13):
    cell = ws[f"F{row}"]
    if cell.value is not None and cell_has_bold_format(cell):
        bold_name_count += 1

ws["K12"] = bold_name_count

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
wb2 = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
ws2 = wb2.active
recomputed = sum(
    1 for row in range(7, 13)
    if ws2[f"F{row}"].value is not None and bool(ws2[f"F{row}"].font.bold)
)
print("Wrote K12:", ws2["K12"].value, "type:", type(ws2["K12"].value).__name__)
print("Original computed bold-name count:", bold_name_count)
print("Whole-cell-bold recomputed after save:", recomputed)
print("Saved to:", output_path)
